limitations: The theorem applies to the first maximum-norm QR pivot under a shared real Gaussian sketch of a fixed number of mutually orthogonal nonzero columns with a unique longest column; exact arithmetic and fixed input norm ratios are essential for the stated sharp asymptotic.
title: Exact Gaussian-sketch first-pivot law and sharp runner-up principle
